note: Generated by `python -m meta_agent.src.skills index` from every skill.json under this folder; never edited by hand. A skill is taken by its ref, <id>@v<version>; sha256 is over the skill's folder.

skills.summary: the smallest gap that is still a stated multiple of the largest particle in the sample
skills.description: Lower bound on the measuring gap from the size of the largest particle in the sample. Take it when gap is a parameter and the sample is a suspension, an emulsion or anything with a largest structure.

inputs.name: particle_diameter
inputs.meaning: the diameter of the largest particle or structure in the sample

inputs.name: gap_to_particle_ratio
inputs.meaning: how many particle diameters the gap must hold; a judgement, bound to a row with its own source

outputs.name: gap_min
outputs.meaning: the lower bound on the gap from the particle size alone

skills.summary: the highest shear rate before secondary flow in a cone-and-plate geometry changes the torque by more than the tolerated amount
skills.description: Upper bound on the shear rate of a cone-and-plate rheometer from fluid inertia, which drives a secondary flow at high speed. Take it when shear_rate is a parameter and the sample's viscosity and density are on the sheet.

inputs.name: critical_reynolds_number
inputs.meaning: the Reynolds number of the gap below which the secondary flow is tolerated; a judgement, bound to a row with its own source

inputs.name: viscosity
inputs.meaning: the viscosity of the sample at the rates in question

inputs.name: density
inputs.meaning: the density of the sample

inputs.name: cone_angle
inputs.meaning: the angle between the cone and the plate

inputs.name: cone_radius
inputs.meaning: the radius of the cone

outputs.name: shear_rate_max
outputs.meaning: the upper bound on the shear rate from the inertia criterion alone

skills.summary: the highest shear rate a cone-and-plate geometry reaches at the instrument's top angular velocity
skills.description: Upper bound on the shear rate of a cone-and-plate rheometer from its top angular velocity. Take it when shear_rate is a parameter and the tool is a rotational rheometer with a cone.

inputs.name: max_angular_velocity
inputs.meaning: the top angular velocity the instrument's specification states

inputs.name: cone_angle
inputs.meaning: the angle between the cone and the plate

outputs.name: shear_rate_max
outputs.meaning: the upper bound on the shear rate from the speed limit alone

skills.summary: the lowest shear rate a cone-and-plate geometry reaches at the instrument's lowest angular velocity
skills.description: Lower bound on the shear rate of a cone-and-plate rheometer from its lowest controllable angular velocity. Take it when shear_rate is a parameter and the tool is a rotational rheometer with a cone.

inputs.name: min_angular_velocity
inputs.meaning: the lowest angular velocity the instrument's specification states it controls

inputs.name: cone_angle
inputs.meaning: the angle between the cone and the plate

outputs.name: shear_rate_min
outputs.meaning: the lower bound on the shear rate from the speed limit alone

skills.summary: the highest shear stress a cone-and-plate geometry measures at the instrument's highest torque
skills.description: Upper bound on the shear stress of a cone-and-plate rheometer from its highest torque. Take it when shear_stress is a parameter and the tool is a rotational rheometer with a cone.

inputs.name: max_torque
inputs.meaning: the highest torque the instrument's specification states

inputs.name: cone_radius
inputs.meaning: the radius of the cone

outputs.name: shear_stress_max
outputs.meaning: the upper bound on the shear stress from the torque limit alone

skills.summary: the lowest shear stress a cone-and-plate geometry measures at the instrument's lowest torque
skills.description: Lower bound on the shear stress of a cone-and-plate rheometer from its lowest torque. Take it when shear_stress is a parameter and the tool is a rotational rheometer with a cone.

inputs.name: min_torque
inputs.meaning: the lowest torque the instrument's specification states

inputs.name: cone_radius
inputs.meaning: the radius of the cone

outputs.name: shear_stress_min
outputs.meaning: the lower bound on the shear stress from the torque limit alone

skills.summary: the largest time step the Courant condition allows on a grid
skills.description: Upper bound on the time step of a grid-based solver from the Courant condition. Take it when time_step is a parameter and the engine advances a flow in time on a grid.

inputs.name: courant_limit
inputs.meaning: the Courant number the scheme is run below; a judgement, bound to a row with its own source

inputs.name: cell_size
inputs.meaning: the smallest cell of the grid along the flow

inputs.name: velocity
inputs.meaning: the largest velocity expected in the domain

outputs.name: time_step_max
outputs.meaning: the upper bound on the time step from the Courant condition

skills.summary: the largest time step an explicit treatment of diffusion allows on a grid
skills.description: Upper bound on the time step of a grid-based solver from the diffusion of momentum or of a scalar. Take it when time_step is a parameter and diffusion is advanced explicitly, or is to be resolved in time.

inputs.name: diffusion_number_limit
inputs.meaning: the diffusion number the scheme is run below; a judgement that depends on the scheme and the dimension, bound to a row with its own source

inputs.name: cell_size
inputs.meaning: the smallest cell of the grid

inputs.name: diffusivity
inputs.meaning: the largest diffusivity in the problem: the kinematic viscosity for momentum

outputs.name: time_step_max
outputs.meaning: the upper bound on the time step from the diffusion condition

skills.summary: the largest time step that still resolves the fluid's relaxation time
skills.description: Upper bound on the time step of a viscoelastic simulation from the relaxation time of the constitutive model. Take it when time_step is a parameter and the transient of a viscoelastic fluid is what is computed.

inputs.name: relaxation_time
inputs.meaning: the relaxation time of the constitutive model

inputs.name: resolved_fraction
inputs.meaning: the fraction of the relaxation time one step may span; a judgement, bound to a row with its own source

outputs.name: time_step_max
outputs.meaning: the upper bound on the time step from the relaxation time

skills.summary: the lowest viscosity whose torque at a given shear rate is still above the instrument's lowest torque
skills.description: Lower bound on the viscosity a cone-and-plate rheometer can measure at a given shear rate, from its lowest torque. Take it when viscosity is a parameter and a shear rate of the measurement is on the sheet.

inputs.name: min_torque
inputs.meaning: the lowest torque the instrument's specification states

inputs.name: cone_radius
inputs.meaning: the radius of the cone

inputs.name: shear_rate
inputs.meaning: the shear rate at which the viscosity is to be measured; the lowest rate of a sweep gives the tightest bound

outputs.name: viscosity_min
outputs.meaning: the lower bound on the measurable viscosity at that rate from the torque floor alone

skills.summary: the density of liquid water at 0.1 MPa against temperature, by the IAPWS supplementary release
skills.description: Density of liquid water at 0.1 MPa as a function of temperature, by the specific-volume correlation of the IAPWS supplementary release SR6-08(2011). Take it when a row needs the density of water between 253.15 K and 383.15 K at or near atmospheric pressure.

inputs.name: temperature
inputs.meaning: the temperature of the water

outputs.name: water_density_iapws_sr6
outputs.meaning: the density of liquid water at 0.1 MPa and the temperature given, the reciprocal of the specific volume

skills.summary: the viscosity of liquid water at 0.1 MPa against temperature, by the IAPWS supplementary release
skills.description: Viscosity of liquid water at 0.1 MPa as a function of temperature, by the correlation of the IAPWS supplementary release SR6-08(2011). Take it when a row needs the viscosity of water between 253.15 K and 383.15 K at or near atmospheric pressure.

inputs.name: temperature
inputs.meaning: the temperature of the water

outputs.name: water_viscosity_iapws_sr6
outputs.meaning: the viscosity of liquid water at 0.1 MPa and the temperature given

skills.summary: the viscosity of liquid water at atmospheric pressure against temperature, by the correlation of Kestin, Sokolov and Wakeham
skills.description: Viscosity of liquid water at atmospheric pressure as a function of temperature, by the two correlating equations of Kestin, Sokolov and Wakeham. Take it when a row needs the viscosity of water between 265.15 K and 423.15 K, or beside another correlation of the same quantity to compare the two.

inputs.name: temperature
inputs.meaning: the temperature of the water

outputs.name: water_viscosity_kestin_1978
outputs.meaning: the viscosity of liquid water at essentially atmospheric pressure and the temperature given

skills.summary: the relative difference between two values of the viscosity of water on one sheet
skills.description: Relative difference between two rows that give the viscosity of water, as a number of its own. Take it when two correlations or a correlation and a measurement of the viscosity of water stand side by side on a sheet.

inputs.name: viscosity
inputs.meaning: the value compared

inputs.name: reference_viscosity
inputs.meaning: the value it is compared with

outputs.name: water_viscosity_relative_difference
outputs.meaning: (viscosity - reference_viscosity) / reference_viscosity

skills.summary: fits stress = consistency * rate ^ flow_index to a flow curve and returns both with the residual
skills.description: Fits a power law to a flow curve, shear stress against shear rate. Take it when a steady shear sweep has been measured and the question is how the stress scales with the rate.

inputs.name: shear_rate
inputs.meaning: the shear rates of the flow curve, a list

inputs.name: shear_stress
inputs.meaning: the shear stress at each rate, a list of the same length

outputs.name: fitted
outputs.meaning: true when a fit was made

outputs.name: flow_index
outputs.meaning: the exponent of the power law

outputs.name: consistency
outputs.meaning: the stress at a shear rate of one reciprocal second; its unit carries the flow index

outputs.name: residual_rms_log
outputs.meaning: root mean square of the residuals of ln(stress)

outputs.name: points
outputs.meaning: how many points were fitted

outputs.name: value_kind
outputs.meaning: computed

outputs.name: basis
outputs.meaning: how the numbers were computed, naming this skill and its version

outputs.name: why
outputs.meaning: why no fit was made

skills.summary: brings the instrument from switched on to ready: the person's steps, initialise, home, and a last check
skills.description: The boot sequence of the instrument, from switched on to ready. Take it when read_status does not return ready and the instrument has just been switched on. It changes the device, so it is held until a person releases it.

inputs.name: person_confirmed
inputs.meaning: the numbers of the person's steps the person has said are done (operator_read)

outputs.name: ready
outputs.meaning: true only when the last check returned ready

outputs.name: stopped_at
outputs.meaning: the step the sequence stopped at, or null

outputs.name: why
outputs.meaning: why it stopped

outputs.name: waiting_for
outputs.meaning: person, when a person's step is not confirmed

outputs.name: refused
outputs.meaning: true when the gate refused the call it stopped at

outputs.name: error
outputs.meaning: the error contract a tool returned, unchanged

outputs.name: verdict
outputs.meaning: the verdict of read_status at the step it stopped at

skills.summary: calibrates one quantity as the profile says the device allows: its own routine, a design drafted with the person, or a gap
skills.description: Calibrates one quantity the way the tool profile says the device allows. Take it when a reading rests on a calibration that is absent or expired. It reads the profile's self_calibration claim first and takes one of three ways; one of them changes the device, so the skill is held until a person releases it.

inputs.name: quantity
inputs.meaning: the quantity to calibrate, as the tool profile names it

inputs.name: self_calibration
inputs.meaning: the tool profile's self_calibration list, unchanged: quantity, mode, claim

inputs.name: instrument
inputs.meaning: the instrument's name, for the design draft

outputs.name: mode
outputs.meaning: self | assisted | unknown, read off the profile's claim

outputs.name: calibrated
outputs.meaning: true only when the device's routine returned a number with an id and an expiry

outputs.name: calibration
outputs.meaning: self: name, value, unit, source calibration:<id>, value_kind, expires; no grade is stated

outputs.name: calibration_design
outputs.meaning: assisted: a calibration_design draft; reference, interval and limit are the person's

outputs.name: open_questions
outputs.meaning: assisted: what the person is asked before the design can be confirmed

outputs.name: gap
outputs.meaning: unknown: what, where it was looked for, and what would settle it

outputs.name: refused
outputs.meaning: self: true when the gate refused the routine

outputs.name: error
outputs.meaning: the error contract the tool returned, unchanged

outputs.name: why
outputs.meaning: why no calibration number was returned

outputs.name: found

outputs.name: identity

outputs.name: session_closed

outputs.name: why

outputs.name: error
outputs.meaning: the error contract a tool returned, unchanged

skills.summary: runs one steady shear step at the plan's shear rate and duration, then stops the motor
skills.description: Runs one steady shear step at a shear rate and for a duration the plan gives, then stops the motor. Take it when the plan asks for a steady shear measurement and read_status returns ready. It changes the device, so it is held until a person releases it.

inputs.name: shear_rate
inputs.meaning: the shear rate the plan gives for this step

inputs.name: duration
inputs.meaning: how long the plan holds the rate

inputs.name: max_polls
inputs.meaning: how many times the caller lets the skill read the state while the step runs

outputs.name: completed
outputs.meaning: true when the device returned to ready by itself and stop was called

outputs.name: stopped_at
outputs.meaning: check_state | set | start | poll, or null when completed

outputs.name: why
outputs.meaning: why it stopped

outputs.name: refused
outputs.meaning: true when the gate refused the call it stopped at

outputs.name: error
outputs.meaning: the error contract a tool returned, unchanged

outputs.name: verdict
outputs.meaning: the last verdict of read_status

outputs.name: run_id
outputs.meaning: the run id the start tool returned

outputs.name: polls
outputs.meaning: how many times the state was read while the step ran

outputs.name: stop_confirmed
outputs.meaning: true when the stop tool answered without an error

skills.summary: reads the modes and the range of each quantity as the device itself reports them
skills.description: Reads what the instrument itself reports about its modes and the range of each quantity. Take it when a plan needs to know what the device says it can do, before choosing any interval.

inputs.name: quantities
inputs.meaning: the names of the quantities wanted; an empty list means all the device reports

outputs.name: reported
outputs.meaning: true when the device answered

outputs.name: modes
outputs.meaning: the modes the device lists

outputs.name: ranges
outputs.meaning: one row per quantity: quantity, min, max, unit, reported_by, tool

outputs.name: missing
outputs.meaning: wanted quantities the device did not report

outputs.name: inconsistent
outputs.meaning: quantities whose row lacks an end or a unit, or whose ends are reversed

outputs.name: why
outputs.meaning: why nothing was reported

outputs.name: error
outputs.meaning: the error contract the tool returned, unchanged

skills.summary: reads the device's state and says ready, busy, fault or unknown
skills.description: Reads what state the instrument is in through its status tool and returns ready, busy, fault or unknown with the readings. Take it before any step that changes the device and to verify a step that did.

outputs.name: verdict
outputs.meaning: ready | busy | fault | unknown, by the rule in the skill

outputs.name: readings
outputs.meaning: what the status tool returned, unchanged

outputs.name: value_kind
outputs.meaning: measured: the readings are the device's own, taken in this call

outputs.name: measured_at
outputs.meaning: the device's time on the reading, or null when it gave none

outputs.name: run_id
outputs.meaning: the run the reading belongs to, or null outside a run

outputs.name: why
outputs.meaning: why the verdict is unknown, when the tool returned an error

outputs.name: error
outputs.meaning: the error contract the tool returned, unchanged
